SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY File No. S. B. D. ... Date ...）
Date December 31, 1935.

Subject Communication dated December 13, 1935, from H.B.M. Consulate-
General re Mario Andreoni.

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Ross.

Mario Andreoni, age about 32, native of Italy, arrived
in Shanghai some four years ago as an officer on board an
Italian naval vessel. Early in 1934 he married a Miss
Mooser, the daughter of E. Mooser, an American Jew film
magnate. Mrs. Mooser who is divorced from her husband,
is living with Mr. and Mrs. Andreoni at 1419 Avenue Joffre.
During the autumn of 1934 Andreoni, accompanied by his
wife, proceeded on leave to Italy and while there he resigned
his commission. During the early part of 1935 he returned
to Shanghai in quest of employment. On 23rd August, on
the recommendation of a well known local banker, he was
engaged in the Salt Gabelle where he was given a minor
position as a musketry instructor. On 4th October, pleading
as an excuse that his wife wished him to secure a position
that would necessitate his remaining in Shanghai, he resigned
from the Salt Gabelle. Since that time he has been
unemployed.
Despite the fact that he has no visible income he lives
on a fairly luxurious scale and numbers among his friends
many influential people. He was on friendly terms with
Mr. Edwin S. Cunningham, until recently American Consul-
General in Shanghai. Andreoni is a member of the French
Club where he is frequently to be seen.

（签名）
D. I. R.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Br.)

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局特务科登记处 档案号 S. B. D. ... 日期 ...）
日期：1935年12月31日。

事由：英国驻上海总领事馆于1935年12月13日发来的关于马里奥·安德烈奥尼（Mario Andreoni）的公函。

由 D. I. Ross 撰写并转呈。

马里奥·安德烈奥尼，约32岁，意大利人，约四年前作为意大利海军舰艇上的军官抵达上海。1934年初，他娶了穆瑟小姐（Miss Mooser），她是美国犹太裔电影大亨 E. 穆瑟（E. Mooser）的女儿。穆瑟夫人已与丈夫离婚，现与安德烈奥尼夫妇同住于霞飞路1419号。1934年秋，安德烈奥尼携妻赴意大利休假，期间辞去了军职。1935年初，他回到上海寻找工作。8月23日，经一位当地知名银行家推荐，他被盐务稽核所（Salt Gabelle）录用，担任一名次要职务，即射击教官。10月4日，他以妻子希望他获得一份必须留在上海的工作为借口，从盐务稽核所辞职。此后他一直失业。
尽管他没有可见的收入来源，但生活相当奢华，且朋友圈中不乏许多有影响力的人物。他与最近才离任的美国驻上海总领事埃德温·S. 坎宁安先生（Mr. Edwin S. Cunningham）关系友好。安德烈奥尼是法国总会（French Club）的会员，人们经常在那里见到他。

（签名）
D. I. R.
副总监（特务科）

（印：... REC. D...）

H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.

13. 10. 35.

Personal

My dear Givens,

I should be much obliged for any information
you could let me have concerning an Italian named Mario
ALDRONE of 1419 Avenue Joffré.

（批：To record in
officer's
book）
I should be grateful if the enquiry could be
made with utmost discretion.

Yours Sincerely,
（签名）

T. P. Givens Esq.,
Special Branch Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road.

$ 2, For very discreet
enquiries please.
JMG

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

1935年10月13日。

私人信件

亲爱的吉文斯：

如蒙提供有关居住在霞飞路1419号的意大利人马里奥·阿尔德罗内（Mario ALDRONE）的任何信息，我将不胜感激。

（批注：记入
警官
日志）

如能极其谨慎地进行查询，我将感激不尽。

此致
敬礼，
（签名）

T. P. 吉文斯先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科，
福州路。

$ 2, 请务必进行非常谨慎的查询。
JMG

December 31 35.

My dear Barton,
With reference to your letter dated
December 13, 1935, I forward herewith for your
information a copy of a report regarding an
Italian named Mario Andreoni.
Yours sincerely,

J. Barton, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.

A.A.D.）
